postings.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib.
Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day.
Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good.
  • Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state.
  • Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets.
  • Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM.
  • Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team.

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

postings.title: Research Scientist (x/f/m)
postings.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Doctolab team (Doctolib Clinical AI Research Lab).

Your mission is to build accurate, well-calibrated, and clinically reliable models of patient health, learned from health data at scale. The work is both fundamental and applied: you publish, and your models reach products used by doctors and patients. Doctolib is used by around 450,000 health professionals and 90 million people across Europe, and research that succeeds in the lab can be deployed at that scale.

Working at Doctolib means contributing to one of Europe's leading health-tech companies, and seeing your work improve care for patients and practitioners.

How we work

Doctolab is a research lab in its founding phase, so researchers have real influence over its direction and its priorities. We work closely with the data science and product teams, and we stay close to the data.

We expect researchers to explain why a question matters, not only why it is open. Projects are chosen on both scientific ambition and what they change for patients and practitioners. The work suits researchers who want to see their results used.

The questions we raise are open problems in machine learning: world models that predict the consequences of an action, calibration and uncertainty, causal inference from observational data, multimodal sequence modelling, orchestration between model capabilities. Results on these questions hold well beyond healthcare. We are in a strong position to work on them: we have the data to learn a world model from, a clinical use case that defines success, and the engineering path to put it in front of practitioners and patients and learn from what comes back.

Experience with healthcare or medical data is a plus but not required. Both early-career and experienced researchers are welcome.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build a world model of patient health: how a health state evolves over time and changes in response to care, learned from observational data with the confounding accounted for
  • Build evaluation methods that test calibration, robustness, interpretability, privacy, and generalization outside the training distribution
  • Work with the data science and product teams to turn research results into clinical-grade features
  • Publish at leading machine learning and health informatics venues
  • Engage the international health and machine learning community through open collaboration: data challenges, shared benchmarks, and open-source releases
  • Help define the lab's research agenda and its working relationship with the rest of the company

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have a PhD in machine learning, statistics, computer science, or a related field, or a Master's degree with significant research experience
  • Have depth in one or more of: representation learning and self-supervised learning; large language models and multimodal modelling; causal inference and causal discovery from observational data; temporal and dynamic modelling; calibration and uncertainty quantification; agentic systems and orchestration; evaluation and benchmarking; privacy auditing of machine learning models
  • Have first-author publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or comparable medical informatics venues
  • Have driven your own research, from choosing the question to publishing the result
  • Are proficient in Python and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch, and have trained models yourself
  • Are comfortable working with large and imperfect real-world data
  • Can explain why a research question matters, scientifically and for patients or practitioners
  • Are fluent in English, the working language of the lab

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with healthcare or medical data, clinical text, or electronic health records
  • Have taken research models into production, or worked alongside product teams
  • Have released open-source code, benchmarks, or datasets

postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

The role

As a regulated payment provider, we must ensure we manage operational risk and our regulatory requirements correctly. We do this by having a robust control framework across some of our business-critical areas, like payments and billing.

This role will be central to ensuring our 1st line Operations teams continue to implement, manage, test and regularly update controls frameworks. You'll manage the end-to-end controls framework for our operational teams, including but not limited to Payments Operations, Billing and Credit Control. You will be a key point of contact for managing our annual Safeguarding and SOC1 audits, engaging with auditors and gathering and submitting evidence.

The role provides an excellent opportunity to work with the broader Enterprise Risk community and shape the controls environment for a fast-growing FinTech, putting your stamp on how controls are designed, implemented and managed. 


What excites you 

  • Designing and implementing controls. Working with the Regulatory Compliance team to understand the complete picture of the control landscape and then collaborating with 1st line control owners in our Operation to  implement relevant controls 
  • Control assessment and reporting. Updating the safeguarding and SOC1 controls assessments on a regular cadence
  • Direct control management. Managing key controls within our Internal Operations teams
  • Understanding existing processes and re-designing controls to meet current and future business needs
  • Working with the Regulatory team to ensure audits are completed successfully, including explaining our first-line controls to auditors and regulators
  • Improving efficiency through the standardisation, automation or removal of controls
  • Building positive relationships with stakeholders across the different lines of defence to help develop a real understanding of our risk exposure, control environment, deficiencies and gaps
  • Autonomy to drive change from the ground up 

What excites us  

  • Have worked in a regulated environment, preferably financial services or at a FinTech 
  • Previous experience working in a similar role, such as Audit, you’re skilled in designing, implementing and testing the effectiveness of controls
  • You're a great communicator. You can simplify and clearly explain the what and why behind the controls you implement
  • You understand how to balance compliance and operational efficiency
  • You have a solid understanding of the three lines of defence and have experience working with Regulatory Compliance teams as well as external auditors
  • You have great attention to detail, you work in a structured manner and you’re comfortable with data
  • You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where your responsibilities can evolve and change 
  • You're a self-starter and can work independently with minimal supervision

 

Base salary range: 2867 EUR/ months gross - 4300 EUR/ months gross

 

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

postings.title: Credit Risk Administrator
postings.description:
About us

Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

We are looking for a Credit Risk Administrator to join our Internal Operations team within GoCardless. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who is looking to develop hands-on experience in credit risk, compliance and payments within a fintech environment.

A little bit more in detail about the role:

Insolvency Case Management

  • Own and manage insolvent merchant cases end-to-end across multiple jurisdictions (currently mainly UK, France, and Spain, with scope to expand)
  • Act as the single point of contact for all internal and external parties involved in an insolvency case
  • Suggest mitigants needed to support the merchant through insolvency, restructuring or business wind-down
  • Coordinate the collection and submission of required documentation from administrators (e.g. proof of debt, claim forms, creditor correspondence)
  • Track and manage the collection and release of funds in line with insolvency proceedings and internal policy, and ensure invoices are correctly reconciled.

Internal Coordination

  • Act as the operational bridge between credit control, legal, finance, and customer-facing teams on all insolvency matters
  • Drive the internal process: chasing stakeholders, flagging blockers, and keeping cases on track
  • Support the novation process for insolvent companies in close collaboration with legal and customer-facing teams
  • Escalate complex or high-value cases to the Head of Billing & Credit Control and the Credit Underwriting team, as appropriate.

Reporting 

  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date insolvency tracker covering all live cases, jurisdictions, and expected recoveries or losses
  • Provide regular case updates and exposure reporting to support month-end close
  • Flag write-off recommendations where recovery is no longer viable

Ticket Management

  • Manage tickets and alerts received via Zendesk for inactive companies, insolvencies, administrations or other notable corporate events.
  • Engage with merchants as needed to understand the necessary context and take action when appropriate.
  • Respond to queries and escalate issues where appropriate

This role works Monday - Friday, 10 - 19, in a hybrid way. During the probation period, you could be asked to come to the office.

The team also works on national holidays.

 

What excites you 

  • You'll have real ownership from day one. You're the main point of contact for every insolvency case, inside and out.
  • You'll work across borders. Managing cases under different legal frameworks.
  • You'll be working with senior stakeholders daily. Legal, finance, commercial — you'll build relationships across the business

What excites us  

  • An interest in credit risk, insolvency or financial operations — whether through study, work experience, or a related role
  • Confident in dealing directly with administrators and insolvency practitioners
  • Strong coordination skills — you'll be managing multiple internal stakeholders across different teams simultaneously
  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail across a busy and varied caseload
  • Clear, confident communicator, written and verbal
  • Proactive and self-sufficient — you manage your workload

 

Base salary range: 26,400 EUR - 39,600 EUR

 

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level,

postings.title: Data Analyst II
postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

 

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights. 

  • Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
  • Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
  • Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
  • Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
  • Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)

 

What Excites You

  • Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features. 
  • Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
  • Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
  • Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across th

postings.title: Data Engineer
postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Data at GoCardless 

You'll sit in our Data and Business Systems group, working with technical and non-technical people across the whole company. You'll be part of a collaborative data engineering team, working closely with analytic engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions that scale with our rapidly growing business.

We're a large team with an extensive remit, and we expect every member to work with initiative and be driven — holding each other accountable and to a high standard. Joining our team, you'll work alongside people who strive to be the best they can be, on complex projects across GC's data and business systems stack.

Our technologies: We endeavour to build simple, reliable systems, and we believe in using the best technology for each task. Technologies we use across GoCardless include Python, Google Cloud Platform, dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, and others.

You're not expected to have expertise in all of these — most of our team have picked up tools once they've started working with us.

The Role

We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to help us build and maintain robust, scalable, and efficient data infrastructure - from ingesting data from third-party sources, to the pipelines and orchestration that move our data, to the models that shape it.

Working closely with analytic engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you'll help transform raw data into valuable insights that drive business decisions.

We're hiring across a range of experience levels - from engineers developing pipelines and models independently, through to those leading the design of larger, higher-scope systems.

The main elements of this role will involve:

  • Data modelling and pipeline development: Design, develop, and iterate data models and schemas, and build ETL/ELT pipelines to process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.
  • Data infrastructure development: Implement and maintain scalable data architectures and pipeline orchestration (scheduling, dependencies, retries) using cloud technologies, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Data quality and governance: Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems.
  • Collaboration and delivery: Work closely with engineers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, analysts, and business teams across the company to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that meet their needs.
  • Technical innovation: Stay current with emerging data technologies and best practices, proposing and implementing improvements to our data infrastructure and processes.
  • Documentation and knowledge sharing: Create and maintain technical documentation, share knowledge with team members, and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Be a reflection of the GC Values that help us work with one another effectively.

Who we're looking for

You'll enjoy this role if:

  • You're passionate about working with data at scale and solving complex data challenges - whether that's shaping how data is modelled, how it moves, or how reliably it's delivered.
  • You write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, and care about getting the details right.
  • You enjoy collaborating across diverse teams, and can translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • You think critically and solve problems methodically - debugging complex data issues and optimising system performance.
  • You take ownership of your work, proactively looking for ways to improve it.
  • You're eager to l

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

Riga is a key engineering hub for GoCardless, an important stand-alone hub with over 200 people. All of the core Connectivity group is based there, the team that builds and runs every bank debit and open banking connection we offer, owning the full problem space end to end: build, operate, on-call and incident management, the same way any of our other groups do. 

We need someone to do three main things: ensure Connectivity delivers as a core group, responsible for all core banking connections and file submissions, managing billions of pounds in submissions every month, work that has to run flawlessly, every day; be the engineering site leader for Riga, working with local leadership to make the office a destination for people; and help advocate for and hire in Riga, working with grassroots training schools and communities to make GoCardless a destination for local talent.

What excites you 

  • Owning the roadmap - strategically plan our reliability and future delivery with other senior leaders, while prioritising technical investment with a clearly articulated ROI.
  • Shaping a growing hub - genuine scope to shape what Riga becomes next: how Connectivity operates at scale, and how we attract, grow and retain local talent.
  • Embracing change - you have a growth mindset, open to new ideas and change, while staying committed to focus and speed.
  • Cutting through the complexity - you're a self-starter who can take ambiguous problems that may be outside your experience and apply first principles thinking and reasoning to decompose, hypothesise, test, execute and deliver.
  • Being customer obsessed - you focus on the outcomes and impact for customers in the work we deliver.
  • Delivery - you thrive on getting things done, and on enabling those around you to get more done.
  • Being a player-manager - you can deep dive into technical problems and future architecture, and earn the respect of senior engineers along the way.
  • Excellence - you recognise the importance of building a high-performance engineering culture, and have a view on how to get there.

What excites us  

  • Experience of building and managing agile teams or departments of 20+ people, including managing both managers and individual contributors up to Principal level.
  • Experience of working at scale, where security and operational excellence are critical to success.
  • Delivery - someone who ensures project work is delivered, estimates are accurate, time is tracked and velocity is measured and used to improve the team.
  • Clear communication - concise, regular communication to a leadership team, often non-technical, on progress against strategy and team objectives.
  • A strategic mindset - comfortable tackling long-term roadmaps and our longer-term problems and vision.
  • Comfortable being based in our Riga office; this isn't a remote role.

Base salary range: €97,600 - €146,400

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

postings.title: Salesforce Developer  (12 month fixed term contract)
postings.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

As a GoCardless Salesforce Developer, you will own the integrity and strength of the solutions you recommend. You’ll be acting as a trusted advisor to our team and internal customers. You will need a deep understanding of the Salesforce platform with specific experience in Sales Cloud, and deep knowledge of either CPQ or, preferably, Agentforce Revenue Management. Top-notch people skills to get your ideas and solutions across to stakeholders are required and the ability to deliver solutions and help grow experience within the team to do the same.

The Salesforce Developer will form a key foundation for a new team within GoCardless, Salesforce Development, to expedite cross-functional changes across our business systems. You will be responsible for delivering meaningful changes to the business, working alongside other Salesforce Developers, Administrators, Integration Architects, Business Analysts and Business Intelligence to collaborate on specifications based on stakeholder requirements, validate the proposals, and deliver the solutions.

What excites you

  • Collaborate with the Commercial & Operational arms of the organisation, business analysts and other stakeholders to validate business requirements and any considerations (security, scalability, limits), and deliver those changes using the whole of the Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud platforms.
  • Enhance integrations: use Salesforce APIs to integrate with other systems used in the organisation.
  • Follow Best Practices: adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write/maintain test classes for all custom development,
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code. 
  • Integrate and maintain business applications to Salesforce, such as DocuSign, Qualtrics, Kernel, and marketing tools etc.
  • Help grow knowledge and best practice within the team and the wider business.
  • Assist with development of quality assurance.
  • Use our DevOps and Quality tooling to deploy reliable consistent enhancements.

What excites us

Experience & Education:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce development experience underpinned with strong Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ product knowledge.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications e.g. Certified Salesforce Administrator, Certified Salesforce Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in IT, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience. 

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Apex, SOQL, VisualForce, Java, and Lightning components
  • Strong knowledge of CPQ or Revenue Cloud, including product catalogue build, pricing strategies, product rules, pricing rules and approvals automation.
  • Experience in all core elements of Salesforce Sales Cloud configuration.
  • A proactive attitude to Salesforce enhancements and bringing existing code and configuration into best practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce architecture and custom coding
  • Familiarity with business process analysis and CRM systems
  • Ability to write, interpret, and critique technical specifications.
  • Experience working with large data sets and bulkification.
  • Soft skills: the ability to gather requirements and present solutions to stakeholders.
  • A self-starter, experienced in leading projects or delivery work streams.
  • Able to collaborate and communicate effectively with business stakeholders / other Salesforce team members.

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Platform Engineering at GoCardless

The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team. We are currently located in London, Riga, and Lisbon.

We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products.

We operate with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.

Our work is a balance of:

  • Project Delivery: Building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.
  • Operational Support: Ensuring the health and stability of our systems through on-call rotations and incident management.
  • Business as Usual (BAU): Continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.

Tech stack and tools:

  • Python, Ruby, Golang;
  • Terraform;
  • Atlantis 
  • AWS, GCP;
  • Kubernetes, GKE;
  • Github, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD;
  • Grafana, Prometheus;
  • Datadog

What excites you:

We use a wide range of technologies, and will never expect you to have experience with all of them. We do hope that you are enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. To enjoy this work you’ll be excited by:

  • Building and maintaining automation of new and existing infrastructure;
  • Appreciate and believe in building easy-to-understand and maintain tools to solve problems;
  • Automating operational tasks to eliminate toil using your software development skills and experience;
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats;
  • Working closely with software engineers and data scientists;
  • Being involved in the technical design of architecture and making technical decisions;
  • Cloud-first engineering;
  • Ongoing opportunities to further develop your skills;
  • Care about working with people who share the same values as you and who will continually push you to grow.

  • Experience with cloud computing providers such as AWS or GCP;
  • Experience with containerized applications;
  • Previous experience with container orchestration such as Kubernetes and GKE will be considered an advantage;
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Github, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.;
  • Experience working with monitoring tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, etc.;
  • Experience with relational databases and other datastores, especially around high availability and performance optimisation;
  • Awareness of DevOps and Agile principles;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills.

 

Base salary range: £62,400 - £93,600 

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. postings.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Compliance & Prevention Associate to join our Complaints Management & Prevention team on our journey to bring N26 Operations to the next level. Reporting directly to the  Complaints Compliance & Prevention Manager, you will serve as the operational engine executing regulatory remediation deliverables, conducting deep-dive Root Cause Analyses (RCA), performing data population reconciliations, and enforcing compliance checks on complaint handling output across all of our markets with focus on Germany.
 

What You Will Do

  • Remediation Execution: Crucial role in audit findings compliance and remediation, working directly with auditors, remediation teams and management to assure timely delivery of projects and initiatives. 

  • Compliance Maintenance: Draft and update Written Orders (SfOs), Work Instructions, process maps, and operational guidelines to resolve open regulatory action items.

  • Case-Level RCA Investigations: Perform deep-dive case investigations across different complaints’ markets to identify underlying technical, process, or operational root causes rather than surface-level symptoms.

  • Audit Evidence Compilation: Collect, verify, structure, and archive Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Effectiveness (ToE) evidence packages for internal and external control reviews.

  • Quality & Output Compliance: Support qualitative and quantitative compliance verification on complaint output, validating SLA calculations, delay communication triggers, and conflict-of-interest checks.


What You Will Bring

  • Minimal requirements: 

    • 4+ years of proven experience in compliance controls, assurance, banking operations or complaints management in German financial space, 

    • full working proficiency in German language.
       

  • Background & Experience: professional experience in consulting, assurance functions, financial regulation, banking quality assurance, or audit support.

  • Functional & Technical Knowledge: Practical understanding of the complaint lifecycle under BaFin MaBeschwer, PSD2, and MaComp standards. Solid working experience with case management and data analysis.

  • Analytical Depth: Strong capability to conduct root cause investigations, trace data discrepancies across multi-system environments, and produce clear, structured process documentation.

  • Languages: Fluent English required as well as professional working proficiency in German. 

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.

postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a Data Scientist to build production-ready applications. Our Data Science team develops practical machine learning applications to enable innovative and customer-facing product features.

In this role, you will:

  • Own well-scoped projects from data exploration and feature engineering through modelling to deployment, with guidance from senior colleagues on larger or more ambiguous problems.
  • Contribute to solutions in financial crime prevention and credit risk assessment that reach customers.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver customer value.
  • Support junior colleagues through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.
  • Have the opportunity to experiment with new tech stacks and project ideas.

What you need to be successful (Background and Skills): 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a focus on quantitative disciplines including mathematics, statistics, or computer science.
  • Practical experience (typically 2–4 years) developing machine learning solutions, with at least one model taken to production. Experience in banking, fraud detection, or credit risk is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with a range of modelling techniques, including:
    • Classification and regression models: (e.g., CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM)
    • Time Series Analysis: (e.g., ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet)
    • Unsupervised Models: (e.g., clustering, anomaly detection such as Isolation Forest)
  • Solid understanding of model evaluation, including handling imbalanced data, validation strategies, and calibration.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure (e.g., Docker/containers, CI/CD, GitHub Actions) and the ability to ship and maintain your own code.
  • Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts (neural networks, transformers, autoencoders) and at least one framework (TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch).
  • You are organised and self-motivated, and can drive projects forward independently while knowing when to ask for input.
  • Language skills: English (full professional proficiency).

  • Knowledge of the banking industry (regulatory and compliance, PD/LGD/EAD modelling, credit card fraud, anti-money laundering).

  • Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Early experience mentoring or onboarding colleagues.

postings.description:
About us 

N26 is Europe’s leading digital bank with a full German banking license. Headquartered in Berlin and operating across more than 20 markets, we are now entering our next stage of maturity. Our focus is on our growth engine while we strengthen robustness, scalability, and operational excellence. With new senior leaders joining to guide this phase, we are sharpening how we build, ship, and sustain products at scale.

Our core strategy focuses on empowering customers to switch to N26 as their primary account. By embedding financial tools that are reliable and resilient, we ensure N26 is an essential part of everyday life. postings.title: Head of Product, Core Banking Systems
postings.description:
About the opportunity

 

N26 is looking for a Head of Product - Core Banking Systems to partner with our Engineering, Treasury, Risk, and Banking Operations teams. In this role, you will own the Core Banking Systems product roadmap and lead a team of product & business managers delivering foundational capabilities that power N26 — from rapid product configuration to balance sheet infrastructure and regulatory reporting.

You will work at the intersection of Core Banking architecture, financial data integrity, and compliance on one side, and real-world banking and product challenges on the other. Your mission is to transform Core Banking Systems from a cost center into a composable platform that enables product managers to configure and launch products in days, embeds compliance by design, and lays the foundation for growth beyond N26. You will be the connective tissue between technical platform excellence and business outcomes, ensuring that our core engine powers flawless banking across N26 and eventually external financial institutions.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Own and drive the Core Systems product roadmap across Product Enablement (lending, deposits, payments gateway) and Balance Sheet Infrastructure (financial data products, treasury, books & accounting), balancing near-term execution with long-term strategic horizons.

  • Partner closely with N26 Product Segments and functional stakeholders across Treasury, Credit Risk, Risk Controlling, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting on priorities, planning cycles, and shared OKRs.

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Core Banking initiatives — from self-service product enablement and third-party vendor in-housing through migration, platform scalability, and iteration.

  • Define and roll out core platform best practices across the organization — including product configuration standards (Product Factory), ledger data integrity, evaluation frameworks, and progressive rollout guardrails.

  • Contribute to N26's company-wide strategy to establish single sources of truth for financial data, eliminate core vendor dependencies, and reduce risk concentration across endpoints.

  • Support domain optimization by transitioning stable, non-core services to appropriate segment owners while maintaining operational excellence and zero material audit findings.

  • Manage and develop a team of Core Systems Product Managers, fostering a culture of operational rigor, precision, and platform enablement.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to other Product & Tech teams looking to integrate with core banking engines, sharing best practices and enabling rapid go-to-market execution.

  • Manage stakeholder communication across Product, Engineering, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.

  • Define and track domain KPIs that measure product enablement speed, system uptime, compliance metrics, OPEX cost savings, and balance sheet data integrity.

 

What you need to be successful:

 

  • 5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on core banking systems, ledger infrastructure, payments, or core platform products.

  • Proven experience partnering with Core Banking and Platform Engineering experts — you understand how transaction processing, ledgers, and accounting engines work and know how to build scalable platform products.

  • Strong technical literacy — you understand backend platform trade-offs, core endpoint dynamics, multi-currency ledgers, and data pipelines, allowing you to engage credibly with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven mindset — comfort working with complex financial datasets, defining meaningful operational and compliance KPIs, and making decisions grounded in evidence.

  • Financial services experience required — familiarity with regulatory requirements, audit standards, compliance considerations, and the operational realities of banking.

  • Agile practitioner — experience managing multiple mission-critical workstreams in fast-paced, high-availability environments.

  • Excellent communication skills — the ability to translate complex technical and financial concepts for non-technical audiences and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.

postings.title: Strategy & Operations Associate: Customer Risk Lifecycle
postings.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a highly driven Steering & Planning Associate for our Customer Risk Lifecycle (CRL) domain, helping achieve N26’s ambition to be a pioneer in the prevention of Financial Crime.

This presents a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge initiatives in an ever-changing space to safeguard N26 customers from fraud, scams, and digital identity attacks, and safeguard the bank against money launderers and money mules through their whole risk lifecycle.

You will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between strategy and execution, helping N26 grow and run better by translating ambitious goals into clear KPIs and tangible results. In this role, you will be part of a high-impact team that acts as a strategic partner to leadership, driving value and business resilience across our core risk and compliance lines.

If you are interested in learning how we leverage technologies like Machine Learning and Generative AI end-to-end—from a front-end UX perspective to back-end and staff tooling at onboarding, device pairing, payment, and card transactions—this position is for you! You will be working on initiatives that are at the heart of all risk-based decisions that support new and existing product propositions while ensuring compliance with future regulations.

In this role, you will:

  • Help ensure the Anti Financial Crime Strategy is well-defined, owning and refining the segment strategy to enable data-driven trade-offs across the Customer Risk Lifecycle.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, developing a deep understanding of business drivers, infrastructure, and processes related to financial crime prevention and staff investigations.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing workflows and performance metrics to identify inefficiencies, streamline processes, implement automation, and support scalable business growth.
  • Monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with company objectives, proactively reviewing data and performance insights.
  • Identify and prioritize key product and strategic initiatives to deliver against our KPIs, uncovering opportunities to optimize the user experience and risk-rate customers effectively.
  • Manage and maintain critical vendor and external service provider relationships, ensuring strong collaboration, performance tracking, and compliance with SLAs and risk management protocols.
  • Develop business cases to evaluate the cost, impact and value of new opportunities.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, ensuring strong project management, clear ownership, timely delivery, and continuous optimization.
  • Monitor performance and optimize outcomes, including product KPIs, unit economics, and external partner delivery against SLAs.
  • Act as the central connector across teams and partners, aligning stakeholders (Product, Tech, Data, Growth, Finance, etc.), resolving blockers, and driving execution on complex, high-impact topics in a dynamic environment.

What you need to be successful:

Background:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in fast-paced environments such as fintech, banking, consulting, startups, or corporate strategy roles—ideally within regulated industries or financial services
  • Bachelor's degree in STEM, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Management or a related field from a top-tier university.
  • Strong understanding of scalable process design, automation technologies, and standardization best practices.
  • An analytical mindset to deconstruct complex problems with a focus on delivering data-driven impact.

Skills & Traits:

  • Project management experience, particularly in cross-functional teams with Product, Tech, or Operations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams in a multicultural environment across various areas of expertise.
  • Comfortable working independently on compliance and regulatory-related topics and engaging with relevant stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Agile mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive, growth-oriented attitude.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills; fluency in Excel and project management tools is essential.
  • Proficient in SQL and confident in working with data to drive decisions.
  • Strong storytelling and visual communication skills using PowerPoint.
  • Passion for the banking and fintech industry, with a desire to deepen understanding of how N26 operates.
  • Experience with operational processes optimization and understanding key drivers of customer satisfaction are a plus.

As an Intern in the Vendor Management Team at N26, you will support the team in managing and improving vendor partnerships that power our banking infrastructure and key operational services. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, regulated environment and contribute to the operational backbone of one of Europe’s leading digital banks. postings.title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Bank Balance
postings.description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. 

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we’d love to hear from you.

The Vilnius team is a core part of the Global Bank domain. We own production systems, shape technical direction, and work closely with colleagues across SumUp’s global offices on critical merchant banking capabilities. Join our Vilnius Team today (Vilnius office).

What You’ll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp’s core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You’ll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You’re comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • You’re eager to learn about relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It’s a plus if you have

  • Knowledge of Elixir - some of our legacy services are written in Elixir, and while it's not essential, it would be useful if you've worked with it before
  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp 

🌎 We’re a truly global team of 3200+ skilled professionals from 92+ countries, spread across 4 continents. Join the team from our Vilnius office.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

🏖️ Time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus special holidays

🏥 Peace of mind: health insurance through Gjensidige and life & accidental coverage from Ergo

💪 Stay active: gym membership allowance to help you keep fit on your terms

📚Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship

postings.title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers Europe
postings.description:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp’s internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll take ownership of services that process real money. You’ll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we’d love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you’ll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team’s domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Improve service reliability and quality by writing tests, enhancing monitoring, and following established delivery pipelines.
  • Support the operation of the systems you work on by participating in on‑call rotations, incident response, and learning from post‑incident reviews.
  • Apply a backend and systems perspective during refinement, raising questions about risks, dependencies, and edge cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and other engineers to deliver end‑to‑end transfer and banking capabilities.

You’ll be great for this role if you

  • Have experience building backend services in a modern environment and supporting them in production.
  • You are proficient in Golang and and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed
  • Are comfortable working with cloud‑based systems, containerized workloads, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Raise well-scoped pull requests, conduct thorough code reviews, and help maintain high standards of code quality and test coverage across the team
  • Understand the fundamentals of system architecture, data modelling, and API design, and are eager to deepen this knowledge.
  • Are curious about how your work fits into the broader system and product experience.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Exposure to banking, payments, or financial systems, especially in regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with production traffic, including participating in incident response.
  • Use of AI‑assisted tools to improve development speed, learning, or code quality.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

postings.description:
About the team:

We are the Merchant Risk Intelligence team within SumUp’s Risk & Compliance tribe. We build systems that help protect SumUp and its merchants from fraud while supporting reliable, compliant business growth.

Our team combines software engineering, machine learning, data science, product management and risk expertise. You will join a multidisciplinary group currently working across backend services, data products and AI-powered solutions. The team is growing its software engineering capabilities to develop Sentinel, our entity-level investigation and actioning framework, and to support broader risk and compliance use cases.

You will bring dedicated backend expertise to the team. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful collaboration and the ability to balance delivery speed with security, reliability and long-term maintainability. Most of our codebase is written in Go, but we are open to candidates who have solid backend experience with other language(s) and are willing to pick up Go on the job. You will collaborate with great Go engineers in the tribe and you will be able to learn from them.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Develop new functionality and support existing services across the tribe’s codebase, primarily using Go.
  • Contribute to the continued development of our in-house merchant risk decision framework, taking it beyond its MVP and enabling new fraud prevention, risk and compliance use cases.
  • Design, build and maintain reliable distributed systems and backend services.
  • Work closely with product managers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, fraud strategy teams and operational stakeholders to turn complex problems into practical solutions.
  • Help shape technical direction, service boundaries and system design decisions across the team.
  • Contribute to Python projects, including AI-agent initiatives, as you build a broader understanding of the team’s systems.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, monitoring and continuous improvement of production services.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to deliver meaningful features faster without compromising code quality, security or maintainability.
  • Be open to participating in an on-call rotation as the team’s production responsibilities and support model evolve.

 

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

  • Professional experience developing backend software in Go or another language such as Java, C or C++; you’re motivated to learn and work with Go.
  • Experience building and operating distributed systems and backend services
  • Strong system design skills and an understanding of reliable, maintainable software architecture.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and Kafka
  • Working knowledge of Python and/or an interest in contributing to Python-based products or AI/agentic development
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools as part of your software development workflow
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating with stakeholders beyond engineering

Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally by offering a high-quality banking experience tailored to their needs - effortless, simple, and affordable.

Joining the Global Bank tribe means playing a key role in helping us build SumUp's digital bank. Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s’agit d’un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu’à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l’intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu’à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l’organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d’évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d’encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d’aisance orale, d’énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s’ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d’ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d’une carte de frais professionnels, remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d’entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d’avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne

postings.title: Consultor de Ventas - Autonomo
postings.description:
Consultor de Ventas

Sobre nosotros

Los grandes vendedores no esperan oportunidades, las crean.

Buscamos perfiles orientados a resultados, con mentalidad comercial fuerte y ganas de construir algo propio mientras ayudan a los pequeños negocios a crecer.

Las pymes y comercios en España son la base de nuestra economía y necesitan una plataforma de pagos y gestión financiera diseñada para su realidad. Eso es exactamente lo que ofrece SumUp, y estamos ampliando nuestro equipo comercial para llegar a negocios en todo el país.

Descripción del rol

Buscamos un Consultor de Ventas para desarrollar negocio en tu territorio asignado.

Estarás en contacto directo con propietarios de pequeños y medianos negocios, ayudándoles a descubrir cómo las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp pueden mejorar su operativa diaria.

Este es un rol para personas que disfrutan vendiendo cara a cara, generando sus propias oportunidades y construyendo relaciones comerciales sólidas.

Desde el primer día tendrás autonomía para desarrollar tu mercado, construir tu pipeline y cerrar acuerdos.

Qué harás

  • Identificar y captar nuevos clientes, especialmente pequeños y medianos negocios.

  • Generar oportunidades comerciales mediante prospección, networking y puerta fría.

  • Realizar reuniones presenciales y demostraciones de producto.

  • Explicar el valor de las soluciones de pago y gestión financiera de SumUp.

  • Construir y gestionar tu propio pipeline comercial.

  • Gestionar objeciones y cerrar acuerdos de forma efectiva.

  • Crear relaciones de confianza a largo plazo con los comercios de tu cartera.

  • Alcanzar y superar objetivos comerciales de forma constante.

Encajarás si...

  • Tienes experiencia en ventas B2B, Field Sales o desarrollo de negocio.

  • Has trabajado generando tus propias oportunidades comerciales.

  • Tienes experiencia en prospección, generación de leads y construcción de pipeline.

  • Estás acostumbrado a trabajar por objetivos.

  • Conoces bien el tejido empresarial local y los retos de los pequeños negocios.

  • Te sientes cómodo vendiendo cara a cara y desarrollando relaciones comerciales.

  • Eres autónomo, resiliente y orientado a resultados.

Por qué unirte a SumUp

  • Bonus mensual de 500€ sujeto a Partner Status.

  • 50% de los ingresos generados por pagos, hardware y software.

  • 20% de ingreso recurrente sobre tu cartera durante dos años.

  • Potencial de generar ingresos recurrentes a largo plazo.

  • Formación práctica en producto, ventas y desarrollo comercial.

  • Acompañamiento continuo por parte de un Territory Manager.

  • Libertad para gestionar tu territorio y desarrollar tu propio negocio.

Diversidad e inclusión

En SumUp creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación. Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y valoramos a todas las personas independientemente de su origen, género, identidad de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

SumUp no acepta currículums no solicitados de agencias externas. Las candidaturas deben enviarse directamente por los propios candidatos.

Data Platform Engineer (Mid-Level)

Onsite Role - Office First

Team description

As part of the Platform tribe, we're building a self-service, AI-ready Data Platform that powers SumUp's next big bets: data, AI, and real-time analytics. Our team designs and runs the infrastructure that lets data engineers, analysts, and ML teams across the business ship reliable pipelines and products without reinventing the wheel each time. This role sits at the centre of that work, giving you a genuine chance to shape how thousands of SumUppers build with data every day.

What you'll do

  • Build and evolve the data platform's infrastructure (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled, and auditable
  • Take end-to-end ownership of the reliability, performance, and scalability of the Data and AI platforms
  • Develop self-service features, including for ETL and orchestration, so teams can move faster without bespoke integrations
  • Automate operations to keep the platform highly available and cost-efficient as demand grows
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and shape adoption strategies that improve platform capabilities and business outcomes
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than one-off integrations

  • More than 4 years of experience building internal platforms consumed by other teams, in a Data, Platform, or Software Engineering role
  • Strong software engineering background in Python or Go, along with solid SQL skills
  • Hands-on knowledge of infrastructure and containerisation, such as Terraform, Helm, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Comfort working with observability, monitoring, alerting, and platform reliability engineering practices
  • Experience in modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake, Trino, Airflow, etc.) 
  • Track record of setting up SDLC practices for analytics teams, including Git workflows, CI/CD, testing, and documentation standards

It's OK if you don't meet 100% of these criteria. If you're missing a few, it just means you'll have room to learn and grow with us.

postings.title: Fullstack Engineer - Bank
postings.description:
SumUp gives small businesses the tools they need to get paid, manage their money, and grow - today, over 4 million merchants across 37 markets worldwide rely on SumUp to do exactly that.

The Bank Web squad sits within SumUp's Banking domain and owns the web experience across our banking surfaces - from the business account dashboard that merchants use daily, to the back-office tooling that powers the support teams behind them. The team has a clear mission: make Bank Web a genuinely first-class platform, on par with our mobile applications in quality, reliability, and performance.

Joining now means being part of a team that’s at a key growth point - modernization work, growing scope across markets, and making architectural decisions that will shape how millions of merchants experience SumUp's banking products.

👉 Take a look at our Sofia office

What you'll do

  • Build and own features end-to-end across our web banking surfaces - from scoping and component implementation through testing, observability, and production maintenance
  • Work across the full stack - including defining API contracts, working with backend proxies, and integrating with the services that power our banking platform
  • Contribute to modernisation efforts, including architectural improvements, component refactoring, and stack migrations that reduce technical debt and accelerate future delivery
  • Review peers' pull requests with attention to UI consistency, accessibility, and frontend best practices
  • Participate in production support and incident reviews, helping to strengthen the squad's operational resilience across its web domain

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript, with a track record of delivering production-ready features end-to-end -not just isolated UI components
  • Genuine full-stack capability: Experience defining API contracts, working with backend proxies, and owning integrations, not just consuming them; backend experience in Node, Kotlin, Java, or Golang is valued
  • Solid understanding of frontend architecture, component design patterns, state management, and how frontend applications connect to backend services
  • Experience writing and maintaining frontend tests (unit, integration, snapshot, end-to-end) and a genuine care for code quality and reliability
  • Comfort navigating a complex, multi-stack codebase. React and TypeScript are core to this role, while our broader ecosystem also includes Node.js, Kotlin, Java, Go, Angular, AWS and Kafka. Prior experience with all of these is not required, but familiarity with most of them is a plus
  • Curiosity about complex domains - banking products have intricate user flows and edge cases, and you enjoy digging into them to find the right solution
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and getting changes safely to production; exposure to AI tooling to augment engineering workflows is a plus

Global Finance – Accounting

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

This role sits at the centre of our global finance ecosystem, ensuring accounting excellence, operational consistency, and scalable financial infrastructure across regions.

Your impact will go far beyond managing transactional accounting. You will unify regional structures under one global operating model, elevate leadership capability within local teams, and embed automation and process discipline that directly improve reporting accuracy, close timelines, decision-making quality, and adhere to strict ICFR compliance.
